content: All 6 stereocenters are recognized. Now generate 3D coordinates with explicit hydrogens:

args.command:
python3 - << 'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
mol = Chem.MolFromMolFile('mol.mol')
mol = Chem.AddHs(mol)
params = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
params.randomSeed = 42
cid = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol, params)
print('embed', cid)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mol, maxIters=2000)
Chem.MolToMolFile(mol, 'mol3d.mol')
# write xyz
conf = mol.GetConformer()
lines = [str(mol.GetNumAtoms()), 'mol_0241 3D']
for a in mol.GetAtoms():
    p = conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
    lines.append(f'{a.GetSymbol():<2} {p.x: .6f} {p.y: .6f} {p.z: .6f}')
open('answer.xyz','w').write('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
print('written', mol.GetNumAtoms())
# verify stereo retained
m2 = Chem.MolFromMolFile('mol3d.mol')
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m2)))
PY
